environment: macOS ARM64; Docker PostgreSQL 17; local Uvicorn/Firebase Auth Emulator; Docker k6 2.3.0; not a cloud benchmark
mix: Four read iterations (search/detail/availability/preview) for each review/confirm/cancel iteration; overlapping requests deliberately conflict
interpretation: The SRS error rate excludes expected HTTP 409 conflicts. Raw k6 http_req_failed includes expected conflicts and is not the SRS error rate. Warm-up has 30 interrupted iterations at its boundary, excluded from steady metrics. This small local dataset does not establish free-tier cloud performance.
